messages:
tara: Attempting the Node quickstart on my laptop. The sample app dies on "first call" with a confusing mix of errors. CLI shows TLS handshake error then later an auth/billing error.
alex: Can you paste the exact output? Is this happening behind a corp proxy or any VPN?
tara: Running on mac, corporate VPN active. Quick repro: `node sample.js` -> logs: 
1) Error: write EPROTO 140079736105344:error:...:SSL routines:ssl_choose_client_version:unsupported protocol
2) After retry: {\"error\":\"billing_required\",\"message\":\"workspace needs billing setup\"}
I didn't expect billing to show up for a brand new trial org.
jin: Two likely causes: 1) VPN/proxy is downgrading TLS or doing MITM, leading to EPROTO; 2) workspace trial not accepted so server returns billing_required once connection negotiated. They can appear in sequence depending on how the client retries.
alex: If the quickstart uses NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED override or a proxy that rewrites SNI, handshake fails. Try setting REDWOOD_API_URL to http://127.0.0.1:8443 and tunnel to avoid name mismatch, or accept billing on the org console.
tara: repro steps I ran: `export REDWOOD_API_URL=https://api.play.redwood.ai` then `curl -v --resolve api.play.redwood.ai:8443:127.0.0.1 https://api.play.redwood.ai:8443/v1/health -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"` -> returns billing_required JSON when resolve used, but without resolve I hit EPROTO.
jin: Sounds like overlapping infra + policy issues. Action items: add a small troubleshooting note to quickstart about VPN/proxy/TLS and a clear line about billing gating meaning you'll see 402/402-style errors once org hasn't accepted trial. Also adjust client logging so transport-layer TLS errors aren't swallowed and we show their root cause.
devex-bot: Created DEVEX-1140: "quickstart: clarify VPN/proxy TLS behavior + explicit billing gating message" assigned to jin.
tara: For now workaround: run quickstart off VPN or accept trial in the org console. Thanks!
